retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style album cover featuring a vertical split between large-scale condensed sans-serif typography and a framed studio portrait.

recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, white-background composition featuring a large, vertically stacked typographic block on the left and a rectangular photographic portrait on the right, utilizing a primary palette of vibrant red and cyan.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast color blocking between red and cyan text
Asymmetrical balance between heavy left-aligned text and right-aligned tracklist
Framed portrait acting as a secondary focal point
coreInvariants: Split-complementary red and cyan color scheme

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium close-up portrait is positioned in the center-right, occupying approximately 40% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold red title at the top left serves as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-left title down through the blue and red stacked text, jumping to the portrait, and finally to the small-scale tracklist on the far right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous white margins and gutters between text blocks and the central image.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for text against a high-value, neutral background.
paletteRestrictions: Black (for small metadata and glasses frames)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold condensed sans-serif for impact paired with wide-tracked serifs for technical metadata.

preserve: Alternating red and blue text blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed grotesque feel of the main titles.
Provides the mid-century commercial sans-serif aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a clean white square canvas. In the center-right, place a rectangular studio portrait of a smiling man with glasses, framed by a thin cyan border. Leave the left third and top/bottom edges completely empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, condensed uppercase sans-serif text in the left-aligned area. Alternate between bright red and cyan for different lines. Add a small, wide-tracked serif header at the very top in cyan. Place a vertical list of small cyan text on the far right.

verificationChecks: Is the main text left-aligned and condensed?
Are the colors limited to red, cyan, and white?
Is the portrait framed as a distinct rectangle?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of red to cyan text
postGenerationChecks: Check that no text is illegible or overlapping.
Ensure the red and cyan colors are vibrant and not muted.
Verify the portrait does not dominate the entire frame.
Confirm the layout feels like a 1960s print product.
recipe.reuseFormula: Condensed Sans-Serif + Split-Complementary Colors + Asymmetrical Portrait Inset = 1960s Commercial Aesthetic
